criteria.text: `Source` (`src/types.ts`) includes `'camara'`; `Person` includes an optional `camaraId?: string`; `pnpm typecheck` passes.

`src/collectors/camara.ts` exports `camara: Collector` with signature `(persons: Person[]) => Promise<RawDoc[]>`, built only from `sequential`/`sleep`/`slowGet` in `src/http.ts` — no bespoke retry/fetch logic (manual review of the diff; no direct `fetch(...)` or hand-rolled `setTimeout` retry loop in the file).

A person with no `camaraId` produces zero HTTP requests and zero thrown/logged errors from the collector (unit-level check via a stub/mock in manual verification, since collectors are integration code and untested directly per `CLAUDE.md`).

Every `RawDoc` the collector can produce has `source: 'camara'` and `tone` either `undefined` or absent — never a number (code review + the fixture doc round-tripping with `tone: null` in the DB, criterion 8).

`src/collectors/index.ts` registers `camara` in the `collectors` record but **not** in `defaultSources` — `pnpm ingest` with no arguments does not include it; `pnpm ingest camara` runs it alone. (`defaultSources` array literally excludes `'camara'`; `collectors.camara` is defined — checkable by reading the file.)

`src/store.ts`'s `tonedSources` stays exactly `['gdelt', 'gkg']` — a camara doc always lands with `tone = null` in the `docs` table even in the pathological case a collector bug sets `RawDoc.tone` (covered by `store.test.ts`'s existing tone-suite pattern, extended with a camara case).
`parseSourceList('camara')` returns `'camara'` (test in `test/server.test.ts`, following the existing `parseSourceList` assertions at lines 8-32).
`parseRisingQuery({ source: 'camara' })` and `parseTimelineQuery({ source: 'camara' })` both resolve `source` to `'camara'`, not `'all'` (new assertions, `test/query`-adjacent suite — see Test plan).

Adding the new `camara` fixture doc to `test/fixture.ts` requires **zero** changes to any pinned literal (PMI, stats, tone averages, timeline buckets) in any existing test file — verified by running `pnpm test` after only touching `test/fixture.ts`, `git diff` shows no other test file changed.

The new fixture doc round-trips: `personsMentioned` tags it with exactly the one person named in its injected prefix (no other tracked person), and its row in `docs` has `tone = null`, `source = 'camara'` (new assertions in `test/store.test.ts`).

`seed.json` gains `camaraId` only on entries that are verifiably sitting/former federal deputies (candidates flagged for the builder to confirm against a live `dadosabertos.camara.leg.br/api/v2/deputados` lookup before merging: Nikolas Ferreira, Eduardo Bolsonaro, Hugo Motta, and — with the caveat that his floor-speech era predates the ingest window and he will simply never surface a doc — Jair Bolsonaro). No fabricated/guessed numeric ID reaches `seed.json`; a candidate the builder cannot verify is left without `camaraId` rather than guessed.

`README.md`'s "Run" section documents `camaraId` in the seed bullet, adds a `camara` paragraph (API, no-key, window, domain) next to the `gdelt` paragraph, and states its opt-in status in the `pnpm ingest` command block, mirroring the existing `gdelt` line.
`pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck` both pass on the final diff.
